newsitem.title: USA: US charges AMR affiliates with violations.
newsitem.headline: US charges AMR affiliates with violations.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Transportation's aviation enforcement office Monday charged AMR Corp unit American Airlines and Sabre, its affiliated reservation system, with violations of its regulations.

In a complaint to be heard by a DOT administrative law judge, the enforcement office said that reservation software distributed by American to travel agents contained biases in favor of American and its commuter affiliate, American Eagle.
The complaint seeks an order requiring the companies to cease further violations as well as assessment of civil penalties of over $500,000.
AMR Corp spun off SABRE Group Holdings Inc in July.
